about.paragraph_1: Hey everyone! To be completely transparent: I don't actually play Naruto 5e myself.
about.paragraph_2: I ended up here because of a friend of mine who helps manage the massive Google Sheets for the game. I work in cybersecurity and do a lot of programming in my off time, so when I heard that he was manually handjamming thousands of rows of raw data, I couldn't resist the opportunity to build something that could help make his work a lot easier and by extension help you guys out too. Helping people is what I like to do, and programming is fun, so the idea came naturally.
about.paragraph_3: That's how N5etools started. It's an offline, local app inspired by the layout of classic 5etools. The goal is simple: a fast, one-stop web page where players and GMs can search and find all the source material instantly, without having to dig through multiple files or drives. Behind the scenes, the app is designed to look for the latest book updates and pull the text in automatically so you don't have to. I built this thing with the mindset that everything must function with minimal hassle/difficulty to you guys, the end users. No matter how difficult it is for me to build or maintain, my philosophy is to create something that has zero dependencies and works on your local machine, OS agnostic, so you don't have to download extra things to make it work.
about.paragraph_4: I'm here to handle the coding side of things, but since I don't know the rules of the game as well as you guys, I'm relying entirely on you for the game logic. If something looks broken, missing, or could just work better for your sessions, let me know!

faq.a_homebrew: Right now, the focus is entirely on getting the official, core N5E source material running perfectly and updating seamlessly. Once the foundation is rock-solid, I might look into ways for users to add their own custom data, but for now, we're sticking to the official books.
faq.a_internet: Once you have it downloaded and set up on your machine, it runs as a local server, meaning the core reference library works entirely offline. You'll only need internet when the app checks for new sourcebook updates.
faq.a_replace_sheets: Not at all! This is meant to be a companion tool. While the sheets are amazing for character building and active tracking, N5etools is designed to be the ultimate, fast-loading knowledge base for players and GMs to look up rules, jutsu, items, and features on the fly.
faq.a_typo_prefix: Because the app extracts text directly from the source material, errors usually fall into two categories. If the text is wrong in the actual PDF, that's up to the N5E design team to patch. But if the app accidentally mangled the text or put a jutsu in the wrong category, that's a coding bug on my end! Please
faq.a_typo_suffix: so I can fix the layout.
faq.a_updated: Behind the scenes, the app is built to automatically check for the latest versions of the text, extract the data, and update its own internal reference library. You won't need to manually import new updates when a book changes.
faq.a_what_is: Think of it as a fast, searchable digital reference library for your games. It's a local web app designed to look and feel like classic 5etools, bringing the sourcebooks into one clean, responsive interface so you don't have to flip through multiple PDFs or heavy spreadsheets during a session.
faq.a_why_build_prefix: Short answer: I wanted to help a friend. I saw how much manual, exhausting effort went into organizing the data behind the scenes just to keep the game running smoothly for everyone. I realized I could use my programming background to automate the tedious parts, letting the creators focus on making the game fun and letting you guys focus on playing it. See
faq.a_why_build_suffix: if you want the actual how-it-works details.

fco_desc:Your Cooking Tool deals Piercin: Your Cooking Tool deals Piercing damage.
fco_desc:Your Cooking Tool deals Slashin: Your Cooking Tool deals Slashing damage.
fco_desc:Your Superiority Dice become d8: Your Superiority Dice become d8s, and the die used for Tricksters Words becomes a d8 as well.
fco_desc:Skill: Intimidation. When you w: Skill: Intimidation. When you would take the Coerce or Demoralize skill action, you can add 1 Flurry die to the check. If a creature gained a rank of Fear as a result of a skill action you take, they also gain 1 rank of Concussed.
fco_label:Didn't Know You Was Chill Like: Didn't Know You Was Chill Like That
fco_desc:Skill: Deception. When you woul: Skill: Deception. When you would attempt the Lie or Impersonate skill action, you can add 1 Flurry die to the check. On a success, your lie is passed off as genuine based on the context of the lie itself. If you beat the DC by 5 or more, the lie is accepted as the absolute truth and contesting thoughts or opposing truths are treated as the lie, and they must attempt to convince affected individuals of the truth.
feats.title: Feats
gj_illusion_desc:A creature must beat yo: A creature must beat your Save DC by 10 or more to be treated as if it Critically Succeeded on a Genjutsu you cast.
gj_illusion_desc:Creatures whose saving: Creatures whose saving throw result is 2 or more lower than your Save DC are treated as if they Critically Failed.
gj_illusion_desc:You can increase the Il: You can increase the Illusion check DC to identify your Genjutsu by 5.
gj_illusion_desc:You double the range of: You double the range of Genjutsu you cast. Genjutsu with a Touch range instead have a range of 30 feet.
hn_pick_desc:A Weapon with the Fatal pro: A Weapon with the Fatal property cannot have its damage reacted to when used as a part of your first weapon attack or Bukijutsu attack, per turn.
hn_pick_desc:A Weapon with the Mortal pr: A Weapon with the Mortal property ignores Temporary hit points, instead dealing damage directly to a creature's hit points once per turn.
hn_pick_desc:A creature marked with this: A creature marked with this jutsu who would make a saving throw against a jutsu with the Fuinjutsu keyword suffers a -1 penalty, once per turn. This penalty increases to -2 at 10th and -3 at 17th.

A creature marked with this jutsu who would take damage from a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu suffers a -1 penalty to their first attack roll before the end of their next turn. This penalty increases to -3 at 10th and -5 at 17th levels.

A creature marked with this jutsu who would take damage from a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu increases the cost of their next jutsu before the beginning of your next turn by +3. This cost increases to +6 at 10th and +9 at 17th levels.
hn_pick_desc:A creature who fails their: A creature who fails their constitution saving throw also gains one rank of Concussed.
A creature who fails their constitution saving throw also gains one rank of Laceration.
A creature who fails their constitution saving throw also gains one rank of the Weakened condition.
A creature who fails their constitution saving throw instead becomes Berserk, in place of Envenomed.
A creature who fails their constitution saving throw instead gains one rank of the slowed condition in place of Envenomed.
hn_pick_desc:A weapon with the Flurry At: A weapon with the Flurry Attack property can be used to make two weapon attacks as a Bonus Action. Bonus Action attacks made in this way do not add your ability modifier to damage.
hn_pick_desc:Added to your Arsenal. Arse: Added to your Arsenal. Arsenal Tools gain an escalating cost reduction, die-size increase, range, or DC bonus — see Arsenal's Proficiency's own text.
Added to your Arsenal. Arsenal Weapons gain a die-size increase, the Hidden Weapon property, and a +2/+4/+6 damage bonus — see Arsenal's Proficiency's own text.
hn_pick_desc:Attacks of opportunity and: Attacks of opportunity and attacks made as a result of a creature's Reaction, against you are made at disadvantage.
hn_pick_desc:Cast Bukijutsu using Dexter: Cast Bukijutsu using Dexterity in place of Strength for all calculations.
hn_pick_desc:Cast Taijutsu using Dexteri: Cast Taijutsu using Dexterity in place of Strength for all calculations.
hn_pick_desc:If you would deal 15 damage: If you would deal 15 damage with this weapon in a single attack, the target gains +1 rank of Demoralized.
hn_pick_desc:In your arm you have equipp: In your arm you have equipped a small cannon that unleashes a blast of fire on your foes. As an action you can force every creature in a 15-foot cone to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 fire damage on a failed save and half as much on a success. If you have access to another nature release, you can instead use that element's corresponding damage type (Water = Cold). This damage increases by +2d6 at 10th and 17th levels.
hn_pick_desc:Increase this jutsu's criti: Increase this jutsu's critical threat range by +1.
hn_pick_desc:Learns the Earth Breaker ju: Learns the Earth Breaker jutsu, counted as your Wolf Technique. Increase the saving throw damage die to a d10, and instead make two melee taijutsu attacks against a prone target.
hn_pick_desc:Learns the Ichimonji jutsu,: Learns the Ichimonji jutsu, counted as your Wolf Technique. Make one additional attack.
hn_pick_desc:Learns the Judgement Cut ju: Learns the Judgement Cut jutsu, counted as your Wolf Technique. Reduce the additional cost to target the same space to 4 chakras.
hn_pick_desc:Learns the Manipulated Tool: Learns the Manipulated Tools: Blade Kick jutsu, added to your Arsenal.
Learns the Manipulated Tools: Blade Rain jutsu, added to your Arsenal.
Learns the Manipulated Tools: Blade Wall jutsu, added to your Arsenal.
hn_pick_desc:Learns the Triple Windmill: Learns the Triple Windmill Blades jutsu, counted as your Wolf Technique. The jutsu's range is increased to 90 feet.
hn_pick_desc:Learns the Weapon Break jut: Learns the Weapon Break jutsu, counted as your Wolf Technique. Your weapon is treated as a B-Rank or a +2, whichever is higher in the given scenario.
hn_pick_desc:Learns the Weapon Deflect j: Learns the Weapon Deflect jutsu, counted as your Wolf Technique. Bonus damage increases to a d10.
hn_pick_desc:On a hit or failed saving t: On a hit or failed saving throw, once per turn, the target gains one rank of the bleeding condition.
On a hit or failed saving throw, once per turn, the target gains one rank of the corroded condition.
On a hit or failed saving throw, once per turn, the target gains the bruised condition.

On a hit or failed saving throw, once per turn, the target gains the chilled condition. If the target takes a Bonus Action on its next turn, it gains the slowed condition until the end of its next turn.
On a hit or failed saving throw, once per turn, the target gains the envenomed condition.

On a hit or failed saving throw, once per turn, the target gains the weakened condition. If the target takes a reaction before the end of its next turn, at the conclusion of its reaction it gains the restrained condition until the end of its next turn.

On a hit or failed saving throw, once per turn, the target loses the ability to communicate effectively. They also find it difficult to breathe, suffering a -2 to Constitution ability checks and saving throws until the end of its next turn.

On a hit or failed saving throw, once per turn, the target loses the ability to discern allies from hostiles. If a jutsu or Area of Effect would allow them to choose targets, they cannot exclude their allies at will until the end of their next turn.
hn_pick_desc:On a hit, this jutsu forces: On a hit, this jutsu forces a Constitution saving throw, injecting feelings of excess into its target. On a failed save, until the end of the target's next turn, when they would cast a jutsu that would aid themselves, they must recast the same jutsu targeting themselves using their remaining Action and/or Bonus Actions, ignoring the jutsu's normal casting time.

On a hit, this jutsu forces a Constitution saving throw, injecting feelings of greed into its target. On a failed save, until the end of the target's turn, when they would cast a jutsu that would allow them to aid their allies, they instead can only aid themselves.
On a hit, this jutsu forces a Constitution saving throw, injecting feelings of inactivity into its target. On a failed save, until the end of the target's next turn, they gain 1 rank of Slow.

On a hit, this jutsu forces a Constitution saving throw, injecting feelings of jealousy into its target. On a failed save, until the end of the target's next turn, when they would see an allied creature attempt to aid a creature other than themselves, they must attempt to interrupt the aiding effect.

On a hit, this jutsu forces a Constitution saving throw, injecting feelings of malice and aggression into the target. On a failed save, until the end of the target's next turn, if they make an attack or cast a jutsu that targets a creature, they must target the creature closest to them.

On a hit, this jutsu forces a Constitution saving throw, injecting feelings of pride into the target. On a failed save, until the end of the target's next turn, they cannot take a reaction that would reduce damage or grant themselves temporary hit points.
hn_pick_desc:This jutsu adds your Castin: This jutsu adds your Casting ability modifier to the damage rolls.
hn_pick_desc:This jutsu can take on the: This jutsu can take on the shape of Battle Wires of your description at will. You can attempt a grapple check from up to 30 feet away, using Dexterity or Wisdom (illusion) in place of Athletics contested by the target's Wisdom (Illusions).
This jutsu can take on the shape of Iron Claws of your description at will. This weapon has the Critical and Tactical weapon properties.
This jutsu can take on the shape of a Tanto of your description at will. Melee attacks made with this Shadow weapon adds your ability modifier to the damage rolled.
This jutsu can take on the shape of a shuriken of your description at will. Ranged attacks with this shadow weapon have a range of 60 feet, and can be made as a Bonus Action, once per turn.
This jutsu can take on the shape of a sword of your description at will. This weapon gains the Lethal and Deadly weapon properties.
hn_pick_desc:This jutsu reduces its base: This jutsu reduces its base cost by 2.
hn_pick_desc:This jutsu reduces its upca: This jutsu reduces its upcast cost by 1.
hn_pick_desc:This jutsu's base Damage is: This jutsu's base Damage is increased by +1d12.
hn_pick_desc:This jutsu's base cost is r: This jutsu's base cost is reduced by 2.
hn_pick_desc:When you are hit by a creat: When you are hit by a creature's attack, the next time you deal damage to that creature you can Lethal Attack ignoring its normal trigger requirements.
hn_pick_desc:When you are subjected to a: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on a saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.
hn_pick_desc:You can mark a construct, s: You can mark a construct, structure or surface of your choice (at no action cost). When you do, you can teleport to a space within 5 feet of the marked construct, structure or surface as a Reaction to taking damage. The seal then breaks, needing to be reapplied. You can only have 1 seal active in this way at a time.
hn_pick_desc:You can mark a weapon or we: You can mark a weapon or weapon stack with the thrown property (at no action cost). When you deal weapon damage with a ranged weapon attack using the marked weapon, you can spend 10 feet of movement to teleport to a space within 5 feet of the damaged creature.
hn_pick_desc:You have advantage on savin: You have advantage on saving throws to resist any Mental or Sensory Condition.
hn_pick_desc:Your arm is equipped with a: Your arm is equipped with a firecracker that is made for disorienting your foes. As a Bonus Action you can force every creature in a 10-foot cube originating from you to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they become dazed and blinded until the beginning of their next turn.

Your arm is equipped with a secret poison, with which you can coat your weapon to quickly poison your foes when you make a melee attack with a weapon or make a melee Taijutsu attack as part of casting a Bukijutsu. As part of the same action used to attack, you can spend a use of your Prosthetic Attachments. On a hit you deal an additional 3d6 poison damage. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they gain the envenomed condition for 1 minute. If you score a critical hit with this attack, the target instead gains 3 ranks of the Envenomed condition.
hn_pick_desc:Your arm is fitted with a s: Your arm is fitted with a special feather that gives you the ability to teleport in a cloud of mist to avoid taking consistent damage. As a reaction when you would take damage, you teleport up to 30 feet away. The distance you teleport is increased by +15 feet at 10th and 17th levels.
hn_pick_desc:Your arm is fitted with exc: Your arm is fitted with exceedingly sharp shuriken, launched from a wheel bound with extreme tension. As a Bonus Action you may select a creature you can see and make a ranged weapon attack as if using shuriken, with double its normal range. On a hit, you deal 4d4 slashing damage and inflict 1 rank of bleed. The damage die and ranks of bleed increase by +2 at 10th and 17th levels.
hn_pick_desc:Your arm is outfitted with: Your arm is outfitted with a fan you can quickly pull out to gain a boost to stealth. As an action you cloak yourself in divine winds, giving yourself advantage on your next stealth check.

Your arm is outfitted with an indestructible, iron-ribbed umbrella made to absorb damage and disperse it harmlessly around you. As a reaction when you would take damage, you open this umbrella, intercepting the triggering damage and the next instance of damage by 3d4. The damage you reduce is increased by +3d4 at 10th and 17th levels.

Ts have their damage die increased by 1 step and all slashing damage you deal ignores resistance. Additionally, while equipped with this Regalia once per turn when you deal slashing damage you can inflict a rank of bleed.

While equipped with the Flame Regalia you can cast ninjutsu with the Fire Release keyword without needing the HS component. Your A. Ts now deal fire damage and all fire damage you deal ignores resistance. Additionally, while equipped with this Regalia once per turn when you deal fire damage you can inflict a rank of burned.

While equipped with the Gem Regalia you can cast ninjutsu with the Earth Release keyword without needing the HS component. Your A. Ts now deal earth damage and all earth damage you deal ignores resistance. Additionally, while equipped with this Regalia you reduce all damage you take by an amount equal to your Constitution modifier.

While equipped with the Lightning Regalia you can cast ninjutsu with the Lightning Release keyword without needing the HS component. Your A. Ts now deal lightning damage and all lightning damage you deal ignores resistance. Additionally, while equipped with this Regalia once per turn when you deal lightning damage you can inflict a rank of shocked.

While equipped with the Roar Regalia you can cast genjutsu with the Auditory keyword without needing the HS component. Your A. Ts now deal force damage and all force damage you deal ignores resistance. Additionally, while equipped with this Regalia once per turn when you deal force damage you can inflict a rank of Bruised.

While equipped with the Thorn Regalia you can cast bukijutsu with the piercing component without needing the mobility component. Your A. Ts now deal piercing damage and all piercing damage you deal ignores resistance. Additionally, while equipped with this Regalia whenever you are hit with a melee attack a creature takes piercing damage equal to your Constitution modifier. A creature can only take damage from this Regalia twice per round.

While equipped with the Water Regalia you can cast ninjutsu with the Water Release keyword without needing the HS component. Your A. Ts now deal cold damage and all cold damage you deal ignores resistance. Additionally, while equipped with this Regalia you can spend 5 CCD chakra to gain the benefits of having a source of water when you cast a jutsu with the Water Release Keyword.

While equipped with the Wind Regalia you can cast ninjutsu with the Wind Release keyword without needing the HS component. Your A. Ts now deal wind damage and all wind damage you deal ignores resistance. Additionally, while equipped with this Regalia your AC is increased by +1.

technical.feature_advanced_tooling_body: Version 0.1.0 doesn't have any NPC tracking or things from the Bingo Book at this time. It's mainly just character sheets and rule lookups from the five main books for now. The Bingo Book is planned to be added as a future resource for all our DMs out there
technical.feature_multiplayer_body: The whole reason the app is a local web server (auto-opened in a browser tab) rather than a native desktop program is to make this an incremental step later rather than a rewrite — a local server is already client-server under the hood, so opening it up to the network is additive, not architectural surgery. This has been on the roadmap since before v0.1.0 planning even started.
technical.feature_pdf_viewer_body: Let a player or GM open the actual sourcebook PDF pages inside the app instead of needing a separate PDF reader.
technical.feature_roll20_body: I would like to look into Roll20 integration and see if there's a way to open up the app to that ecosystem, so that players could take what I've built and essentially ride on the backbone of Roll20 to play N5e games that way. Needs a lot of research — I'm not even sure if this one is possible at all.
technical.paragraph_1_prefix: On the technical side of the house, most of my programming knowledge is Python. I am familiar with Go and a little bit of Rust, but I'm always down to learn a new programming language and build new programs. My philosophy in programming is automation — I prefer to build programs that require little user input and automatically do things for you. Think of the small things you do every day that you could automate, like checking/filtering emails or searching the web for something
technical.paragraph_1_suffix: specific or niche. Those are the types of things I like to build, and that Python is perfectly suited for: automation, web scraping, creating/editing/parsing Excel or Word documents, updating data files, scheduled tasks, and more.
technical.paragraph_2: However, I am always looking to improve my skills, and creating N5etools is the perfect way to help out a buddy and a couple thousand other people while sharpening my old skills and learning new ones, like creating web servers, working with databases, and using a programming language or two other than Python. To that end, combined with my philosophy for automation and ease of end-user use, I decided to write N5etools in Golang, a programming language developed by Google back in 2009. Golang is widely known for being one of the best programming languages when it comes to portability, as it can compile binaries for Windows, Linux, macOS, and a bunch of other operating systems — though I expect my user base to fall into one of those three camps. If you want a build for your particular operating system and it's supported by Go, shoot me a message and I'll whip one up real quick. If it isn't supported by Go, it's going to have to wait.
technical.paragraph_3: My main concern is to bake all the source books and character creation into the program first, then polish it and add more advanced features in v1.0.0.

titan.greater_missile_racks_line_desc: As a bonus action, you can spend the CCD Drain and target creatures within a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line. Each creature in the line must make a DC %d Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6+3 fire damage and 3d6+3 force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.
titan.shinobi_fortress.name: Temp HP on Summon (Shinobi Fortress)
titan.shinobi_fortress_desc: When your Titan is summoned, it gains %dd4 temporary hit points (not set automatically — this app has no on-summon trigger for a companion to hang that write on, see this field's own doc comment; enter it into Temp HP above by hand). If you also have the Battle Tower upgrade, you can choose to have your Titan take damage your mounted allies would've taken instead, while they're mounted on it.
titan.shinobifall.name: Shinobifall
titan.shinobifall_ability_desc: When you would summon your Titan, you can spend 5 CCD chakra to instead have it appear 30 feet above you, in a space up to 30 feet away, and fall to earth at speed. Each creature underneath the Titan must make a DC %d Dexterity saving throw, taking %dd%d bludgeoning damage and falling prone on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. The Titan itself takes no fall damage.
titan.shinobifall_attack_desc: Spend 5 CCD chakra to summon your Titan falling from 30 feet up. Each creature underneath it makes a DC %d Dexterity saving throw, taking this damage and falling prone on a failure, or half as much on a success.
titan.thermite_grenade_ability.name: Thermite Grenade (Thermite Launcher)
titan.thermite_grenade_ability_desc: As an action, you can spend the CCD Drain and shoot a Thermite Grenade at a space within 60 feet. Each creature within 15 feet of the grenade must make a DC %d Dexterity saving throw, taking %dd8 fire damage and becoming Burned on a failed save, or half as much on a success.
titan.thermite_grenade_attack.name: Thermite Grenade
titan.thermite_grenade_attack_desc: Action: spend the CCD Drain and shoot a grenade at a space within 60 feet. Each creature within 15 feet makes a DC %d Dexterity saving throw, taking this damage and becoming Burned on a failure, or half as much on a success.
titan.thermite_resistance_advantage: Advantage on saving throws to resist the Burned and Corroded conditions (Thermite Launcher).
titan.trait.battery_powered_barrier.desc: All Titans are fitted with a barrier that protects the titan from damage. When a Titan is damaged, it subtracts hit points from its barrier first. The Battery Powered Barrier has a maximum number of hit points equal to twice your Science-Nin level, and on your turn, you can spend increments of 5 chakra from your CCD to replenish 10 of the barrier's hit points.
titan.trait.battery_powered_barrier.name: Battery Powered Barrier
titan.trait.extra_attack.desc: Your Titan can attack twice with the attack action.
titan.trait.extra_attack.name: Extra Attack
titan.trait.gradual_expansion.desc: Your Titan starts off as Large, becoming Huge at 14th level.
titan.trait.gradual_expansion.name: Gradual Expansion
titan.trait.ninja_tool_integration.desc: The Titan's attacks are chakra enhanced.
titan.trait.ninja_tool_integration.name: Ninja Tool Integration
titan.trait.steady_improvement.desc: The Titan gains an additional number of ASI points equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You distribute these points when you craft your Titan, and you can redistribute them during a long rest.
titan.trait.steady_improvement.name: Steady Improvement
titan.trait.titan_specialization.desc: When you craft your Titan, you choose a Titan Specialization for it to following, picking between a Legion Titan, a Monarch Titan, or a Ronin Titan, which grant your Titan additional abilities.
titan.trait.titan_specialization.name: Titan Specialization
titan.weapon_attack_melee_desc: Melee Weapon Attack: reach %s ft., one target.
titan.weapon_attack_ranged_desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: range %s ft., one target.
titan.xo16_gatling.name: Xo-16 Gatling
titan.xo16_gatling_desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: range 60 ft., one target. Action: spend the CCD Drain (5 CCD Chakra per attack, up to 5 attacks against the same target as part of the same action). Each hit after the first this activation adds a stacking +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with the Xo-16 Gatling until the start of your next turn — not reflected in the totals above, apply it by hand on a second or later hit.
traps.section_hint: Built with a Toolkit during downtime, not purchased — see each trap's required Toolkit below. All traps begin at D-Rank; every rank increase adds +4 to the Build DC, +2 to the Save/Notice DC, and +1 damage die.
